description: Surf: ask Gather for a walk of one school's catalog pages, or read where that walk stands. Give unitid; give ask true to record the ask, and leave it out to only read. This tool starts no walk and no run. The ask is one file the box writes, standing asked. Gather's own window on the box PC, when it is open and no run is going, takes the oldest ask, walks the school's catalog in the window, and rewrites the file: walking, then filed (capture, pages_kept, policy_pages_kept) or not_filed, each with words in Gather's own words. Where a walk for the school already stands at asked or walking, no second one is asked for. The answer gives asked, true when this call recorded an ask, and walk, the ask as its file holds it, or null where none was asked. Once a walk is filed, the school's policy pages are chosen from its pages too, so a Rebuild reads them.

ask.description: True to record the ask; left out, the call only reads where the walk stands

unitid.description: The school, by its IPEDS UNITID
